text:
sam: NimbusHealth ready to move POC -> PO. They returned MSA/DPA redlines and asked for Net60. Need quick decision on prepay, POC SLA language, and who signs the order form. cc @marie @harold

marie: Quick read 1 redlines strip our audit clause and add mandatory HSM. For a short POC we should push back on HSM and keep limited audit rights. I can draft a 1-page POC addendum that scopes audit + adds data deletion timelines.

harold: Procurement view 1 they want Net60; finance defaults to Net30. For POCs we usually require either 50% prepay or a PO with approved credit. Also need remit address and tax id on the PO.

finance-bot: Finance flag: Net60 requires credit review. Approvals possible: Net45 + 50% prepay for short trials. Please provide billing contact and W-9.

vikram: SE note 1 POC is on dedicated capacity for ~2 weeks, expected peak ~50 rps. Can't promise production SLOs. Recommend "POC performance objective" (non-binding) e.g. median latency <150ms and include perf annex. I'll run perf Monday.

sec-bot: Security Q received: https://redwood-secure/qs/4120 They insist on customer-managed HSM. For POC we can offer KMS attestation only, not customer HSM.

marie: On signatures: we can accept e-sign from an authorized procurement rep plus attached PO. I'll add clause: "Order Form must be signed by an authorized Buyer rep and include Buyer PO# if issued." Add data deletion = 30 days post-POC in the addendum.

harold: Can Sales accept Net45 + 50% prepay? Customer may push milestone payments but that complicates billing.

sam: Proposal to NimbusHealth: 1) 1-page POC addendum (limits audit, data deletion 30d) 2) Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 3) SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) median <150ms 4) E-sign allowed with PO attached. Any objections?

marie: No objections. I'll draft the addendum and remove mandatory HSM for POC, keep KMS attestation.

vikram: Fine. I'll attach perf results after Monday run.

harold: I'll tell the customer we require 50% prepay and ask them to send PO to procurement@redwood.example. Will collect remit/tax info.

sam: Action recap: @marie draft addendum; @vikram perf run; @harold collect PO/remit/W-9; finance approves Net45+prepay. I'll own e-sign envelope and route once addendum ready. :thumbsup:

sam: Draft order form snippet:
```
Term: POC (2 weeks)
Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 from invoice date
SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) 0 median latency target 150ms
Data: Data deletion within 30 days after POC
```

sam: If no objections I'll push to customer and attach addendum for e-sign.
